messages.subject: TYPE = COMPLEX equivalent in lavaan
parts:
Mplus has a feature that adjusts the standard errors due to nesting by implementing sandwich estimator:

CLUSTER IS variable;

TYPE = COMPLEX

Is there an equivalent in lavaan? If there is, how is it implemented. Thanks very much.
